column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
a commit holding the project it is asked about pins
a project no commit on the default branch holds yet is not pinned
a source whose HEAD is origin's default branch pins that commit, in full
and is pinned once the default branch holds it
and pins the source checkout's commit once origin's default branch holds it
and the gate workflow bootstrap writes checks Felix out at that commit
and with no commit to give, at the placeholder, quoted so YAML reads a string
and with no origin/HEAD, origin/main is the branch asked
bootstrap with no commit to pin says the workflow gets the placeholder
every checkout in the generated workflow is v5, the lowest major on Node 24
the generated workflow checks Felix out at the commit it was given
